description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetNoreferrer' that extends an attribute transform to add 'rel="noreferrer"' to HTML link elements with a different target to prevent malicious activity. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library handling attribute transformation for links.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetNoreferrer
classes.description: A class that modifies HTML link attributes to include rel='noreferrer' for security reasons.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Modifies the 'rel' attribute of a link to include 'noreferrer' when appropriate, for security purposes.
